description_en: Queries the activation status of the application control and web filtering features for the current Alibaba Cloud account. This operation does not require request parameters and always returns the status of these two features
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号的应用程序管控与Web过滤特性开通状态。该接口无需传入请求参数，固定返回上述两项特性
name: GetFirewallFeature

Features.description_en: The list of firewall feature statuses. This list always returns the statuses of application control and web filtering
Features.description_zh: 防火墙特性状态列表，固定返回应用程序管控与Web过滤两项

FeatureName.description_en:
The feature name. Valid values:
ApplicationControl: Application control.
WebFilter: Web filtering
FeatureName.description_zh:
特性名称。取值：
ApplicationControl：应用程序管控。
WebFilter：Web过滤

Status.description_en:
The activation status of the feature. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
特性开通状态。取值：
Enable：已开通。
Disable：未开通
